title: 英文暗記
description: StudyHome-Nextから救出した 英文暗記 の通常方向教材。

modules.title: 英文暗記
modules.subject: 英語
modules.description: StudyHome-Nextから救出した教材データ。source=english

questions.prompt: 私はちょうど今昼食を終えたところです。
questions.explanation: have just finished = ちょうど終えたところ
questions.answer: I have just finished lunch.
acceptableAnswers: I have just finished lunch.

questions.prompt: あなたはスコットランドへ行ったことがありますか？
questions.explanation: Have you ever been to ...? = 〜へ行ったことがありますか
questions.answer: Have you ever been to Scotland?
acceptableAnswers: Have you ever been to Scotland?

questions.prompt: 彼は韓国へ行ってしまった（今ここにはいない）。
questions.explanation: has gone to = 行ってしまって、今ここにいない
questions.answer: He has gone to Korea.
acceptableAnswers: He has gone to Korea.

questions.prompt: 私は四年間ずっと英語を勉強している。
questions.explanation: have been -ing = ずっと〜している
questions.answer: I have been studying English for four years.
acceptableAnswers: I have been studying English for four years.

questions.prompt: 私は若いころ2年間中国に住んだことがある。
questions.explanation: when I was young があるので、過去の一時期の話
questions.answer: I lived in China for two years when I was young.
acceptableAnswers: I lived in China for two years when I was young.

questions.prompt: 私は一週間前に買った時計を昨日なくしました。
questions.explanation: had bought = なくした時点より前に買っていた
questions.answer: Yesterday I lost the watch that I had bought last week.
acceptableAnswers: Yesterday I lost the watch that I had bought last week.

questions.prompt: 私は正午までには昼食を終えているだろう。
questions.explanation: will have 過去分詞 = 未来のある時点までの完了
questions.answer: I will have eaten lunch by noon.
acceptableAnswers: I will have eaten lunch by noon.

questions.prompt: もう一度行けば、彼女は東京に4回いったことになります。
questions.explanation: will have been to = 未来の時点で〜へ行った経験があることになる
questions.answer: She will have been to Tokyo four times if she goes there again.
acceptableAnswers: She will have been to Tokyo four times if she goes there again.

questions.prompt: 私は彼が病気だったと思う。
questions.explanation: think が現在なので、従属節は was sick
questions.answer: I think he was sick.
acceptableAnswers: I think he was sick.

questions.prompt: 私は彼が病気だったと思った。
questions.explanation: thought より前に病気だったことを had been sick で表す
questions.answer: I thought he had been sick.
acceptableAnswers: I thought he had been sick.

questions.prompt: 君が買い物を終えたら車で迎えに行くよ。
questions.explanation: when 節の中では未来の内容でも will ではなく現在完了
questions.answer: I'll pick you up when you have finished shopping.
acceptableAnswers: I'll pick you up when you have finished shopping.

questions.prompt: 彼は彼の娘にかわいい人形をあげた。
questions.explanation: give + 人 + 物
questions.answer: He gave his daughter a pretty doll.
acceptableAnswers: He gave his daughter a pretty doll.

questions.prompt: 彼はかわいい人形を彼の娘にあげた。
questions.explanation: give + 物 + to 人
questions.answer: He gave a pretty doll to his daughter.
acceptableAnswers: He gave a pretty doll to his daughter.

questions.prompt: 私はいとこに素敵なネクタイを買った。
questions.explanation: buy + 人 + 物
questions.answer: I bought my cousin a nice tie.
acceptableAnswers: I bought my cousin a nice tie.

questions.prompt: 私は素敵なネクタイをいとこに買った。
questions.explanation: buy + 物 + for 人
questions.answer: I bought a nice tie for my cousin.
acceptableAnswers: I bought a nice tie for my cousin.

questions.prompt: 彼女はいつも彼女の部屋をきれいにしています。
questions.explanation: keep + O + C = OをCの状態に保つ
questions.answer: She always keeps her room clean.
acceptableAnswers: She always keeps her room clean.

questions.prompt: その知らせは私を悲しませた。
questions.explanation: make + O + C = OをCにする
questions.answer: The news made me sad.
acceptableAnswers: The news made me sad.

questions.prompt: 彼らは新居がとても快適だと分かった。
questions.explanation: find + O + C = OがCだと分かる
questions.answer: They found their new home very comfortable.
acceptableAnswers: They found their new home very comfortable.

questions.prompt: 地球は太陽のまわりをまわっている。
questions.explanation: 普遍的な事実は現在形で表す
questions.answer: The earth goes around the sun.
acceptableAnswers: The earth goes around the sun.

questions.prompt: 彼はいつも自転車で学校に行っている。
questions.explanation: 習慣は現在形で表す
questions.answer: He always goes to school by bike.
acceptableAnswers: He always goes to school by bike.

questions.prompt: 彼はいつも文句ばかり言っている。
questions.explanation: be always -ing は「いつも〜ばかりしている」という不満の感じ
questions.answer: He is always complaining.
acceptableAnswers: He is always complaining.

questions.prompt: 私たちはよく釣りに行った。
questions.explanation: 過去によくしていたことは過去形
questions.answer: We often went fishing.
acceptableAnswers: We often went fishing.

questions.prompt: 学校は4月8日に始まります。
questions.explanation: 時刻表・予定表のような確定した予定は現在形で表すことがある
questions.answer: School starts on April 8th.
acceptableAnswers: School starts on April 8th.

questions.prompt: 次の急行列車はここに10時につきます。
questions.explanation: 交通機関の予定は現在形で表すことがある
questions.answer: The next express train arrives here at ten.
acceptableAnswers: The next express train arrives here at ten.

questions.prompt: もし明日雨が降ったら、家にいるつもりです。
questions.explanation: if 節の中では未来のことでも現在形
questions.answer: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.
acceptableAnswers: If it rains tomorrow, I will stay home.

questions.prompt: 暗くなる前に、私たちは家につくだろう。
questions.explanation: before 節の中では未来のことでも現在形
questions.answer: We will get home before it gets dark.
acceptableAnswers: We will get home before it gets dark.

questions.prompt: 私たちは五分後に東京につきます。
questions.explanation: will be -ing で自然な未来の成り行き・予定を表す
questions.answer: We will be arriving at Tokyo in five minutes.
acceptableAnswers: We will be arriving at Tokyo in five minutes.

questions.prompt: 明日の朝7時にここを出る予定です。（近接未来）
questions.explanation: 近い未来の確定した予定は現在進行形で表せる
questions.answer: I'm leaving here at seven tomorrow morning.
acceptableAnswers: I'm leaving here at seven tomorrow morning.
